mentions.name: Calendar API
mentions.description: A Calendar API built in .NET Core that provides holidays, recurring events, and timezone support.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im building a Calendar API. After working on a .Net Framework application for a long time, I finally started a .Net Core side project. Holidays, recurring events, timezone support, this thing should keep me busy for quite a while....
